summary.allegation: The cardholder says they cancelled their FluxFit Online subscription on 18 March 2025 but were billed 29.99 GBP again on 20 April 2025, and the issuer seeks reversal as a cancelled recurring transaction.
summary.to_defend: Visa requires the merchant to show the disclosed recurring terms and cancellation method, proof of the cardholder's original opt-in, advance notice of the renewal charge, and that no cancellation request was received before the 20 April 2025 billing date.

requirements.title: Recurring terms disclosed
requirements.text: Terms of service disclosing the recurring billing arrangement and the cancellation method.
requirements.finding: The submitted membership terms disclose monthly auto-renewal until cancelled and give two cancellation routes (account dashboard or support email), which meets the wording of this requirement, although the document is the generic published version rather than the copy accepted by this cardholder.

citations.quote: Subscriptions auto-renew monthly at the rate disclosed at signup until cancelled. Members may cancel at any time via their account dashboard or by emailing support@fluxfit.example.

requirements.title: Pre-charge notification sent
requirements.text: Evidence the cardholder was notified of the upcoming charge (typically 7 days in advance) for transactions over a defined threshold.
requirements.finding: The terms promise an email at least 5 days before each renewal, but no copy or send log of a renewal notice for the 20 April 2025 charge of 29.99 GBP was provided; a policy promise is not proof that the notice was sent.
requirements.gap: No dated renewal notification email or email service delivery log addressed to this cardholder ahead of the 20 April 2025 billing.

requirements.title: No cancellation before billing
requirements.text: No record of the cardholder having submitted a cancellation request prior to the billing date.
requirements.finding: Nothing in the file speaks to the cardholder's cancellation claim of 18 March 2025; there is no account activity log, support inbox record or CRM extract showing the absence of a cancellation request before 20 April 2025.
requirements.gap: No subscription status history or support ticket/email search covering 1 March to 20 April 2025 for this account.

requirements.title: Original opt-in
requirements.text: Evidence of the cardholder's original opt-in to the recurring arrangement.
requirements.finding: No signup record, checkout confirmation, consent timestamp or subscription start date for this cardholder was supplied; the only document is the generic published terms, which applies to all members rather than evidencing this cardholder's opt-in.
requirements.gap: No enrolment record (date, IP/device, account email, accepted terms version) tying this cardholder to the recurring arrangement.

alerts.text: The cardholder's specific claim of a cancellation on 18 March 2025 is not answered by any merchant record; confirm the subscription status history and support inbox before representing.
D1 promises renewal notice at least 5 days in advance while the requirement contemplates roughly 7 days' notice; check whether any notice was in fact sent for the 20 April 2025 charge and when.

reasons: Evidence conflicts with the claim or the transaction data

checks.label: Key evidence comes from document text, not only from an image
Images the evidence relies on are fully legible
Every quoted passage was found in the documents
The rule check and the AI recommendation agree

justification: R3 and R4 are unsupported and R2 has only a policy promise, so the case cannot be filed until the merchant supplies account and notification records.
rationale:
The issuer alleges the 29.99 GBP charge of 20 April 2025 followed a cancellation made on 18 March 2025.
The only evidence filed is the generic terms_v3.2 document, which discloses monthly auto-renewal and two cancellation routes and satisfies R1.
No opt-in record, renewal notice or account status log for this cardholder was supplied, leaving R2, R3 and R4 unsupported.
Transaction data (AVS Y, CVV M, 3DS frictionless) supports card validity but says nothing about consent to continued billing or cancellation.
Hold representment until the merchant produces signup, notification and cancellation records for this account.
merchant_requests: Subscription account history for this cardholder showing signup date, plan, status changes and any cancellation request between 1 March and 20 April 2025
Copy of the renewal notification email sent before the 20 April 2025 charge, with the email service send/delivery log showing recipient and timestamp
Original opt-in record: checkout or signup confirmation showing date, account email, accepted terms version and the 29.99 GBP monthly price
Search of support@fluxfit.example and the ticketing system for any message from this cardholder around 18 March 2025, including a nil result export
Billing ledger for this account listing all charges and refunds, confirming the 20 April 2025 charge of 29.99 GBP was the only charge disputed
